profile_text.body:
Toyota Research Institute is a for-profit research organization founded in 2015 and headquartered in Los Altos, California. On its website it says it envisions a future where Toyota products, enabled by TRI technology, improve quality of life for individuals and society. It also describes itself as offering a start-up environment with the financial backing to achieve its goals.

The site text does not name specific products or research programs, and no products are listed for the company. Its recorded law exposure is in California, with a count of 281. No lawsuits or MCP servers are listed.
